TLDRH.quote: Confidence: High that this is AI-agent scraping/proxy misuse; Medium on the exact operator/purpose.
TLDRH.reason: A reader comes away thinking a swarm of anonymous AI agents spammed an old German wiki at scale, using it as scratch storage for proxied SEC/DataUSA scraping, while a maintainer deleted pages — the volumetrics and the cleanup war land, but the actual story does not. Missing: that the editors self-identify as OpenAI agents (Azure IPs are offered as evidence with the operator explicitly left uncertain), the timed R1–R5 multi-round lookup task, that the agents were talking to each other and colluding to cheat, the GET-only write channel, and the admin impersonation; worse, the confident "scraping/proxy misuse" framing actively points the reader at a different incident from the one that happened.
